final_sql:
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)")
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT schools.School,
       schools.NCESSchool,
       frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.dname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS s 
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds 
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' 
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' 
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' 
  AND "Low Grade" = '9' 
  AND "High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
  AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T3.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T3.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.Phone
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
    SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm AS T1
    INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)"
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Website
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s."AdmEmail1"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Admin1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Admin2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Admin3
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND st.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' 
  AND T1.cname = 'Fresno'

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SchoolName
FROM (
    SELECT sc.School AS SchoolName,
           sc.Virtual AS Virtual,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND rnk <= 5;

SELECT schools.EILName
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
    FROM satscores
);

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = 31
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s.MailStreet, t.sname
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 
  AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailState = 'CA' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT sch.Phone, sch.Ext
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sch ON st.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City = 'Hickman' AND Charter = 1 AND DOC = 52

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = '0'
  AND T1.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] * 100.0 / T1.[Enrollment (K-12)] < 0.18;

SELECT School,
       City,
       AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = '1'
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM schools
WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures
FROM schools
WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District'
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) = '1989'
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31;

SELECT COUNT(StatusType)
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND (SOCType = 'District Community Day School' OR DOCType = 'District Community Day School');
SELECT District FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 0 AND City = 'Fresno'

SELECT T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.City = 'Fremont'
  AND T1.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND T2.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND T1.EdOpsName LIKE '%Youth Authority School%';

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
WHERE EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND NCESDist = '0613360';

SELECT schools.EILName AS `Educational Level Name`, schools.School AS `School Name`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`County Code` = '37';

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND schools.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  AND County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.Latitude, T2.`School Type`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.City, T2.`Low Grade`, T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY T1.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT Fname, District
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
)
WHERE Fname IS NOT NULL
  AND Fname IN (
      SELECT Fname
      FROM (
          SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
      )
      GROUP BY Fname
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 2
  );

SELECT f."District Code",
       f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmLName1 AS "Administrator Last Name",
       District,
       County,
       School
FROM schools
WHERE CharterNum = '40';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmEmail2, T2.AdmEmail3
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.DOC = 54
  AND T2.SOC = 62
  AND T2.OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM users 
WHERE Views > 10 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CreationDate) AS INTEGER) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie');

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts p 
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.Age > 65 AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT u.Location
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.Count = (SELECT MAX(Count) FROM tags);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(badges.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(users.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM users
LEFT JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Views > 200;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN p.Id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 58 AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19'

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Revival';

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN comments ON posts.Id = comments.PostId
WHERE comments.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM comments)

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'not well-finished'
           ELSE 'well-finished'
       END AS status
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Id = (
    SELECT c.PostId
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.UserId = 23853
      AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
);

SELECT u.Reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Id = 65041;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.Id = 6347;

SELECT COUNT(v.Id) AS NumberOfVotes
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'DatEpicCoderGuyWhoPrograms';
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = '24') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = '24') AS posts_to_votes_ratio;
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'SilentGhost';

SELECT c.Text

WITH Consumption2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM Consumption2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM Consumption2013 AS t
    JOIN MinConsumption AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption / NumCustomers AS AvgConsumption
    FROM LowestConsumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'A'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
)
SELECT (balance_end.b - balance_start.b) * 100.0 / balance_start.b AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS percentage_increase
    FROM cons
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'A'
    ORDER BY date
    LIMIT 1
),
start_bal AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
),
end_bal AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
)
SELECT (end_bal.balance - start_bal.balance) * 100.0 / start_bal.balance AS increase_rate
FROM start_bal, end_bal;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_low AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_seg ms
      ON ct.Segment = ms.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = ms.min_consumption

SELECT Segment FROM (

        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
               (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
                - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
               / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
        FROM customers c
        JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    )
    ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district t ON a.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE t.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3 AS district, d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.account_id) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) = '93';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM disp
JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' 
  AND dt.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM card 
      JOIN disp d2 ON card.disp_id = d2.disp_id 
      WHERE d2.client_id = c.client_id
  );

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT district_id AS branch_location,
       A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)

JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id 
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' 
  AND t.balance < 0 
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) 
FROM loan l 
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT AVG(t.monthly_total) AS average_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'

JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);

WITH cust_yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT cy.Segment, SUM(cy.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cy.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_yearly cy
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cy.Segment = m.Segment AND cy.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cy.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
            / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
  ) ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct
    FROM cte
)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM avgs;

JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID
WHERE transactions_1k.CardID = 667467;
SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price = 548.4

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Price = 634.8 AND Date = '2012-08-25')
  AND substr(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013');

SELECT GasStationID
FROM transactions_1k
GROUP BY GasStationID
ORDER BY SUM(Amount * Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(Amount * Price) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND Date = '201201'

SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY t.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2
ORDER BY t.Price / t.Amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.CustomerID, T1.Consumption 
FROM yearmonth AS T1 
WHERE T1.Date = '201208' 
  AND T1.CustomerID IN (
      SELECT T2.CustomerID 
      FROM transactions_1k AS T2 
      WHERE T2.ProductID = 5 
        AND T2.Price / T2.Amount > 29.00
  )

SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate = 'high';
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.finishing = 1 ORDER BY T1.birthday ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
                         M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_1
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country c2
        JOIN Match m2 ON c2.id = m2.country_id
        JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = m2.home_player_1
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) AS sub
)

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

SELECT AVG(p.height)
FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT m.home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_2 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_3 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_4 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_5 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_6 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_7 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_8 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_9 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_10 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.home_player_11 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_1 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_2 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_3 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_4 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_5 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_6 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_7 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_8 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_9 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_10 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_11 FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
) t ON p.player_api_id = t.player_api_id;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';
SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_fifa_api_id = T.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A' 
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';
SELECT MAX(T2.home_team_goal) FROM League AS T1 JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.league_id WHERE T1.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT L.name, COUNT(M.id) AS num_games
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Match M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match);
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(PA.id)
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague' AND T3.status IN ('A', 'C');
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2 WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND account_id IN (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
      WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997'
        AND amount = (SELECT MIN(amount)
                      FROM loan
                      WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997')
  );

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND l.status = 'C'
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(amount)
      FROM loan
      WHERE duration > 12
        AND status = 'C'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND T4.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT account_id
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING MIN(date) BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT T1.client_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id
WHERE T3.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25' AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A11 DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.amount
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND T1.date >= T2.date
ORDER BY T1.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT T1.disp_id
FROM disp AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.amount = 5100 AND T2.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832 AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT (t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance AS increase_rate
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND t1.account_id = (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM loan l
      JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
      WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
      ORDER BY l.loan_id
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_of_loan_amount_fully_paid
FROM loan;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT account.account_id, account.frequency
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', account.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2 AS district, district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       d.A3 AS state,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '93%' OR a.date LIKE '1993%'
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT T3.A2
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY T3.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_account_holders
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND d.client_id NOT IN (
      SELECT d2.client_id
      FROM disp d2
      JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d2.disp_id
  );

SELECT d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(loan.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id)
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
WHERE gender = 'M' 
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id 
    FROM district 
    ORDER BY A15 DESC 
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT SUBSTR(date, 3, 2) AS month, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND SUBSTR(date, 1, 2) = '21'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(date, 3, 2);

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id 
FROM trans t 
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' 
  AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU') 
  AND SUBSTR(t.date, 1, 4) = '1998';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND client.gender = 'F';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp p ON a.account_id = p.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND p.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 8000
  AND di.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT district.A2
FROM district
JOIN account ON district.district_id = account.district_id
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(T1.A15)
FROM district AS T1
WHERE T1.A15 > 4000
  AND T1.district_id IN (
      SELECT T2.district_id
      FROM account AS T2
      WHERE T2.date >= '1997-01-01'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'classic' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(card_id) FROM card

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.A15 FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE a.account_id = 532
SELECT account.district_id FROM account JOIN "order" ON account.account_id = "order".account_id WHERE "order".order_id = 33333

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT card.type
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;
SELECT district.A3 FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.client_id = 3541

SELECT d.district_id

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE event_id IN (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    JOIN expense x ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
    HAVING SUM(x.cost) / COUNT(e.event_id) < (
        SELECT SUM(x2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id)
        FROM event e2
        JOIN budget b2 ON e2.event_id = b2.link_to_event
        JOIN expense x2 ON b2.budget_id = x2.link_to_budget
        WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
    )
);

JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.full_name = 'Helen Parr'

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 108 AND superhero.height_cm = 188;

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id IN (
    SELECT hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute
    WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)
);

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN superpower ON superpower.id = hero_power.power_id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 1 AND gender_id = 2;

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id)
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN colour.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN colour.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 0 OR superhero.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' 
AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY superhero_name ASC;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id)
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT T1.attribute_name
FROM attribute AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.attribute_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS inpatient_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count,
       CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '+') * 1.0
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '-') AS ratio;

SELECT P.Diagnosis, L.Date
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = '30609';

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH > 500;

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937' AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5

SELECT AVG(T1.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Admission = '+'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(T2.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= '50';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND substr(Description, 1, 4) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', "First Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Birthday = (SELECT MAX(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination)) 
  AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT T1.Date, (strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(T2.`Examination Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`T-BIL` >= '2.0'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31') GROUP BY Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
ORDER BY T3.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';
SELECT "T-CHO" < 250 FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464 AND Date = '1995-09-04';
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY `First Date` LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2."aCL IgM" FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT COUNT(Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Patient.`First Date` = '1991-06-13' 
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) = '1995'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.`First Date` = '1997-01-27'

SELECT T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

SELECT (SELECT SUM(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18') AND Date LIKE '1981-11-%') - (SELECT SUM(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18') AND Date LIKE '1981-12-%')

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' 
  AND T1.Description >= '1997-1-1' 
  AND T1.Description < '1998-1-1'
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND GPT > 30 AND ALB < 4;
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2 FROM Examination)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P' AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;
SELECT AVG(T2.ALB) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.PLT > 400 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997' AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);
SELECT SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%') * 100.0 / SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%') AS proportion FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND P.Admission = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(MIN(e.`Examination Date`)) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS time_diff
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT Laboratory.UA, Patient.SEX
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ID = 57266
  AND (Laboratory.UA > 8.0 AND Patient.SEX = 'M' OR Laboratory.UA > 6.5 AND Patient.SEX = 'F');
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GOT < 60
  AND substr(l.Date, 1, 4) = '1994';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GPT > 60)
ORDER BY Birthday ASC;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE CAST(Laboratory.LDH AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 600 AND 800;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT P.ID,
       L.ALB,
       CASE
           WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Outside normal range'
       END AS ALB_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT AVG(T3.UA)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN (SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) AS T2
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3
  ON T3.ID = T2.ID AND T3.Date = T2.latest_date
WHERE (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T3.UA < 8.0)
   OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.UA < 6.5);

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(p.SEX = 'M') > SUM(p.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) 
FROM Patient p 
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID 
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 50;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250

SELECT Laboratory.ID, Laboratory.GLU
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) = '1991'
  AND Laboratory.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.WBC <= 3.5 OR T2.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY T1.SEX, T1.Birthday DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50 AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0)

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.HGB > 10
  AND l.HGB < 17
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.HCT >= 52 GROUP BY T2.ID HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1984'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 50
  AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992' AND T2.PT < 14
SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT < 45;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.WBC > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.WBC < 9.0
  AND (Laboratory.FG <= 150 OR Laboratory.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
