JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT element, COUNT(element) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE label = '+' AND substr(atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' 
GROUP BY element;

SELECT m.label, SUM(a.element = 'h') * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_1';
SELECT DISTINCT atom.element FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = 'TR151' AND atom.element = 'cl'
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND substr(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) >= 10
  AND substr(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) <= 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE atom.element = 'h' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124';
SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR186';
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR007_4_19'

SELECT A1.element, A2.element
FROM connected C
JOIN atom A1 ON C.atom_id = A1.atom_id
JOIN atom A2 ON C.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
WHERE C.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
);

SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3' UNION SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T3.bond_type) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id 
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id 
WHERE T4.label = 'TR346' 
GROUP BY T1.atom_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS double_bond_molecules,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) 
FROM connected 
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id 
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1');
SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' INTERSECT SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=' AND molecule.label = 'TR024';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(molecule.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS atom1 ON connected.atom_id = atom1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS atom2 ON connected.atom_id2 = atom2.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON atom1.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom1.element = 'h'
  AND atom2.element = 'h'
  AND bond.bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = 'TR008' AND atom.element = 'c';

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T3.bond_type
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = 'TR012'
  AND T1.element = 'c'
  AND T3.bond_type = '=';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'o';

SELECT 
    T2.School,
    T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded'
  AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND schools.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2
  ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(st.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / st.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.cname = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T1.sname,
    T2.CharterNum,
    T1.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno (Directly Funded)'
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' 
  AND `Low Grade` = 9 
  AND `High Grade` = 12;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f 
        ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
INNER JOIN satscores AS t 
        ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND t.`NumGE1500` > 0;

SELECT  s.School,
        s.FundingType
FROM    satscores AS t
        INNER JOIN schools AS s
            ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE   s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING  AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12';

SELECT 
    satscores.sname,
    satscores.AvgScrWrite,
    schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools 
    ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', schools.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', schools.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT schools.School, schools.DOCType
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY schools.School, schools.DOCType
HAVING AVG(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - AVG(frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - AVG(f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
);

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 9, 2;

SELECT 
    frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_FRPM_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOC = 66
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey'
  AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
JOIN schools AS s ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1,
    s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2,
    s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores);

SELECT 
    s.Street, 
    s.City, 
    s.Zip, 
    s.State
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s 
    ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND t.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(sat.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools AS sch
JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sch.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE strftime('%Y', sch.OpenDate) = '1980'
  AND sch.County = 'Fresno';

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.School,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.County 
            ORDER BY st.AvgScrRead DESC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores st 
        ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
) AS ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT schools.EILName
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
    cname AS county
FROM satscores
WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' 
  AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich';

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_avg_opened
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND OpenDate LIKE '1980%';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
    / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND County = 'Orange';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT sc.MailStreet, s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s.MailStreet, sats.sname
FROM satscores sats
JOIN schools s ON sats.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sats.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA';

SELECT COUNT(School)
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND StatusType = 'Active'
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT 
    s.Phone,
    s.Ext
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat 
    ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY 
    sat.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE City = 'Hickman' 
  AND Charter = 1 
  AND DOC = 52;

SELECT COUNT(T1.School) 
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.Charter = 0
  AND T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT 
    School,
    City,
    AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
    AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
    AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = 1
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              / COUNT(s.FundingType),
        2
    ) AS locally_funded_ratio_pct

WITH all_admins AS (
    -- Combine all administrator first-name columns into one list
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
),
top_names AS (
    -- Find the two most frequent first names
    SELECT first_name
    FROM all_admins
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(first_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT a.first_name,
       a.District,
       COUNT(*) AS num_admins
FROM all_admins a
WHERE a.first_name IN (SELECT first_name FROM top_names)
GROUP BY a.first_name, a.District
ORDER BY a.first_name, a.District;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customer(s)
    --                 / number of customers at that lowest level
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_avg;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
        ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (Consumption_2013 - Consumption_2012) * 100.0 / Consumption_2013 AS Percentage_Increase
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest_Increase_Segment,
    (SELECT Percentage_Increase FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest_Increase_Pct,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage_Increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest_Increase_Segment,
    (SELECT Percentage_Increase FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage_Increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest_Increase_Pct;

JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal - M.home_team_goal > 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT L.name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(T1.birthday)) / 365 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) >= '2013'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) <= '2015';

SELECT 
    League.name AS league_name,
    COUNT(Match.match_api_id) AS total_matches
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY total_matches DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(height) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM Player
WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00';

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (
        SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
      )
  AND overall_rating = (
        SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
      );

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50
  AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team AS T2
      JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(T1.player_fifa_api_id) AS left_foot_percentage
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_fifa_api_id = T2.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

SELECT L.name AS league_name,
       SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT SUM(pa.long_shots) * 1.0 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT 
    P.player_name,
    SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY average_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-12-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT SUM(TA2.chanceCreationPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(TA2.id)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
          AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND TA2.date <= '2014-12-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY L.name
HAVING SUM(M.home_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT M.id) 
     > SUM(M.away_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT M.id);

SELECT DISTINCT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT 
    T.team_long_name,
    TA.buildUpPlayPositioningClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag';

SELECT T2.heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND T2.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT T2.overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '2011';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_matches
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT T1.preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T2.birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.weight < 130
  AND PA.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky';

SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'David Wilson';

SELECT P.birthday
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Country AS C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT AVG(M.home_team_goal) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match M
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Poland'
  AND M.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
   OR T1.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
GROUP BY T1.player_api_id, T1.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(T2.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Adam%' 
  AND weight > 170;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT PA.potential
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Doran';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT SUM(T2.overall_rating) / COUNT(T2.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height > 170
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) >= '2010'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) <= '2015';

SELECT player_name 
FROM Player 
ORDER BY height ASC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeed = 31
  AND TA.buildUpPlayDribbling = 53
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing = 32;

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Doran';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', M.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.home_team_goal = 10;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = 61
  AND PA.balance = (
        SELECT MAX(PA2.balance)
        FROM Player_Attributes PA2
        WHERE PA2.potential = 61
  );

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN PA.ball_control ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN PA.id ELSE NULL END)
    -
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN PA.ball_control ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN PA.id ELSE NULL END)
    AS difference
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

SELECT player_name 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Lennon' 
  AND birthday < (SELECT birthday 
                  FROM Player 
                  WHERE player_name = 'Abdelaziz Barrada');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate = 'low';

SELECT C.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Country AS C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Germany';

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T1.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.birthday) < '1986'
  AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT P.player_name, MAX(PA.crossing) AS best_crossing
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY best_crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa 
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180 
  AND pa.volleys > 70;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.volleys > 70 AND PA.dribbling > 70;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_matches
FROM Match
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Belgium'
  AND Match.season = '2008/2009';

SELECT pa.long_passing
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_matches
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name AS league_name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(Player_Attributes.overall_rating) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player 
    ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', Player.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT (
    (SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'))
    -
    (SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'))
) * 100.0 /
    (SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'));

SELECT AVG(TA.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS average_build_up_play_speed
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT SUM(T1.crossing) AS total_crossing_score
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennox';

SELECT 
    T2.chanceCreationPassing,
    T2.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT AVG(M.away_team_goal) AS average_goals
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T 
    ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
JOIN Country AS C 
    ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Parma'
  AND C.name = 'Italy';

FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT pa.potential
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
  AND pa.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T1.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T1.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p 
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
      JOIN Player AS p2 
          ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
      WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II'
  AND TA.date = '2012-02-22';

SELECT T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_short_name = 'LEI'
  AND T2.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT TA.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T 
    ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle'
  AND TA.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT ta.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND ta.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
    AND substr(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT 
    (LD.overall_rating - JB.overall_rating) * 100.0 / LD.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS LD,
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
       AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS JB;

SELECT player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM Player
) AS ranked_players
WHERE height_rank = 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,
        M.home_player_4,  M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,
        M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,  M.home_player_9,
        M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11
     )
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(T1.away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals
FROM Match AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2
  ON T2.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')
 AND T2.player_api_id IN (
       T1.away_player_1,  T1.away_player_2,  T1.away_player_3,  T1.away_player_4,
       T1.away_player_5,  T1.away_player_6,  T1.away_player_7,  T1.away_player_8,
       T1.away_player_9,  T1.away_player_10, T1.away_player_11
     )
WHERE T1.away_team_goal > 0;

WITH young_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE CAST((julianday(datetime('now', 'localtime')) - julianday(birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) < 31
)
SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goal
FROM Match AS m
WHERE m.home_player_1  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_2  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_3  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_4  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_5  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_6  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_7  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_8  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_9  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_10 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
  AND m.home_player_11 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.finishing = 1
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(julianday(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - julianday(P.birthday)) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M 
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, 
        M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, 
        M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, 
        M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, 
        M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, 
        M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, 
        M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country C 
    ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa 
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m 
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,

        m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c 
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p
  ON p.player_api_id IN (
       m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,

       m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(P.height) AS average_height

    SELECT home_player_2  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_3  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_4  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_9  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy UNION
    SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy UNION
    SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT away_player_5  FROM italy UNION
    SELECT away_player_6  FROM italy UNION

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(id) AS num_players
FROM Player
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT 
    (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) 
    - 
    (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  );

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT 
    M.home_team_goal,
    M.away_team_goal
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT 
    MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE L.name = 'Eredivisie'
  AND C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p 
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT 
    L.name AS league_name,
    COUNT(M.id) AS num_games
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name AS full_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T 
    ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE 
        WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 
    END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(PA.id) AS percentage
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT account_id 
        FROM loan
  );

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS year_with_higher_unemployment
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp     ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female client(s): earliest birth date (smaller birth_date = older)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- among those oldest females, keep only the district with the lowest average salary
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(A11)
        FROM district
        WHERE district_id IN (
              SELECT district_id
              FROM client
              WHERE gender = 'F'
                AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                  FROM client
                                  WHERE gender = 'F')
        )
      );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'                          -- approved/running loan with no problems
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'         -- loan date in 1997
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'          -- weekly issuance statement
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MAX(amount)
        FROM loan
        WHERE duration > 12
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp     dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account  a  ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (
    SELECT MIN(date)
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1995-01-01' AND date < '1996-01-01'
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT cl.client_id
FROM client cl
JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date AS account_open_date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH biggest_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
CROSS JOIN biggest_loan bl
WHERE t.account_id = bl.account_id
  AND t.date >= a.date          -- transaction happened after the account was opened
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.client_id), 
        2
    ) AS percentage_of_male_clients
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT
    ROUND( ( t_end.balance - t_start.balance ) * 100.0 / t_start.balance, 2 ) AS increase_rate_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t_start
     ON t_start.account_id = l.account_id
    AND t_start.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans t_end
     ON t_end.account_id = l.account_id
    AND t_end.date   = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
ORDER BY l.loan_id     -- the loan approved "first" on that day
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) 
    AS percentage_fully_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_running_ok
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM account a
JOIN district d
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND (a.date LIKE '1993%' OR a.date LIKE '93%');

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d       ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c     ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di  ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, 
       d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT 
    loan.account_id,
    district.A2 AS district,
    district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account 
    ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district 
    ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    d.A3 AS district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a 
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a 
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS decin_percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '93%';

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM client   c
JOIN district d  ON d.district_id = c.district_id   -- client's home district
JOIN disp     dp ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id     -- accounts the client holds
WHERE LOWER(d.A3) = 'south bohemia'                 -- region name is stored in A3
  AND NOT EXISTS (                                  -- no card linked to any of their dispositions
        SELECT 1
        FROM card cd
        JOIN disp dp2 ON dp2.disp_id = cd.disp_id
        WHERE dp2.client_id = c.client_id
      );

SELECT D.A3
FROM district D
JOIN account A ON A.district_id = D.district_id
JOIN loan L    ON L.account_id = A.account_id
WHERE L.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY D.A3
ORDER BY SUM(L.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT 
    district_id AS branch_location, 
    A2          AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district)
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts

WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN loan ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT 
       d.district_id, 
       d.A2 AS district_name
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT SUM(amount) / 12 AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

SELECT DISTINCT

    c.gender,
    c.birth_date

JOIN disp d  ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id  = d.disp_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_female_accounts

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type AS account_type

JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE d.type != 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts

JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.bank = 'AB'

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district_name
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(A15) AS avg_crimes_1995

        WHERE SUBSTR(date, 1, 2) >= '97'   -- accounts opened in 1997 or later

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_classic_cards

JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'classic'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND c.gender = 'M';

SELECT

                END) / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_issued_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date

SELECT d.A15 AS crimes_1995

WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT account.district_id

SELECT t.*

JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3 AS region
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
