FROM event
JOIN attendance ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', event.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name

JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member

SELECT member.last_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id

SELECT z.county

SELECT major.college

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_funds_received

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spent

             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'outpatients'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_of,
    ROUND(
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

FROM Patient

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- each bond paired with the elements of its two atoms
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS e1,
           a2.element AS e2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- number of bonds per element combination
    SELECT MIN(e1, e2) AS elem_a,   -- MIN/MAX normalizes (C,O) == (O,C)
           MAX(e1, e2) AS elem_b,
           COUNT(*)    AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY MIN(e1, e2), MAX(e1, e2)
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt), 2) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

  AND T1.element = 'c'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a1.element AS element_1, a2.element AS element_2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T1.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY T1.element;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id, 
    m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected con ON b.bond_id = con.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON con.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element AS element_1,
       a2.element AS element_2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN m.molecule_id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percent_triple_bond
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes - carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'no - not carcinogenic'
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR151'
  AND T1.label = '+'
  AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(m.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(m.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h';

SELECT molecule_id, label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic_label,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
       ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
      AND b.bond_type = ' = '      -- double bonds only
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS chlorine_bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT  a.atom_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM    molecule   m
JOIN    atom       a  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id    = a.atom_id
                      OR c.atom_id2   = a.atom_id
LEFT JOIN bond      b  ON b.bond_id    = c.bond_id
WHERE   m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_with_double_bond
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS num_elements
FROM (
    SELECT a.element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'

    UNION

    SELECT a.element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
) AS bond_elements;

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule 
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = 'TR024';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE a1.element = 'h'
  AND a2.element = 'h'
  AND bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_single_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR008'
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR004_7'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM bond
      WHERE bond_type = '#'
  );

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'o';

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
  AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND T2.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)")
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE (sa.NumGE1500 * 1.0) / sa.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 / T1.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.NCESSchool,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.School) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' 
    AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' 
    AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T2.CharterNum,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS `Rank`
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' 
  AND `Low Grade` = 9 
  AND `High Grade` = 12;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T2.School,
    T2.Street,
    T2.City,
    T2.Zip,
    T2.State
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT DISTINCT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
     ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores st 
     ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) > 0.1
  AND st.NumGE1500 >= 1;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode, T2.School, T2.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite, T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR STRFTIME('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.DOC
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS f2
      JOIN schools AS s2 
          ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Total_Enrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY Total_Enrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    schools.School,
    schools.Website
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT 
    f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1,
       s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2,
       s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM satscores AS sa
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools s 
    ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sa.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sa.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Website 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND T2.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sname

    SELECT 
        s.sname,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.EILName
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite, 
    sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.sname AS School_Name,
    s.AvgScrWrite AS Average_Writing_Score
FROM schools sch
JOIN satscores s 
    ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (sch.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sch.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')

   OR (sch.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND sch.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 54 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 52 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange' 
  AND StatusType = 'Merged';

SELECT School, ClosedDate
FROM schools

  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.MailStreet
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s 
    ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK-paying customer
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
MinConsumption AS (
    -- The least amount of consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestCustomers AS (
    -- The customer(s) with the lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.TotalConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN MinConsumption mc
        ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment
       AND cc.TotalConsumption = mc.MinConsumption
),
AnnualAverage AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM LowestCustomers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_vs_SME;

        / COUNT(m.member_id) AS percentage
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN income i
    ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT zip_code
FROM zip_code
WHERE type = 'PO Box'
  AND county = 'San Juan Municipio'
  AND state = 'Puerto Rico';

SELECT event_name 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Game' 
  AND status = 'Closed' 
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT a.link_to_event
FROM attendance AS a
JOIN expense AS e
  ON a.link_to_member = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a
    ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT major.college
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Katy'
  AND member.link_to_major = 'rec1N0upiVLy5esTO';

SELECT 
    m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS mj 
    ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences';

SELECT DISTINCT M.email
FROM member M
JOIN expense E ON M.member_id = E.link_to_member
WHERE E.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN budget.remaining < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(event.event_id) AS percentage_over_budget
FROM budget
INNER JOIN event 
    ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id;

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT (SUM(type = 'PO Box') / COUNT(zip_code)) * 100 AS percentage_po_boxes
FROM zip_code;

SELECT 
    T1.event_name, 
    T1.location
FROM event AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 
    ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE T2.remaining > 0;

SELECT T1.event_name, T1.event_date
FROM event AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget
WHERE T3.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  AND T3.cost > 50
  AND T3.cost < 100;

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE expense.cost > 100;

SELECT z.city, z.county
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m     ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN zip_code z   ON z.zip_code = m.zip
JOIN income i     ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY e.event_id, z.city, z.county
HAVING COUNT(i.income_id) > 40;

SELECT m.member_id,
       m.first_name,
       m.last_name,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_amount
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget  b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1
   AND SUM(e.cost) = (
        SELECT MAX(t.total_spent)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(e2.cost) AS total_spent
            FROM expense e2
            JOIN budget b2 ON b2.budget_id = e2.link_to_budget
            GROUP BY e2.link_to_member
            HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event) > 1
        ) t
   );

SELECT SUM(ex.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense ex
JOIN member m ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget  AS b  ON e.event_id  = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense AS ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
  AND ex.cost < (
        SELECT SUM(ex2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id)
        FROM event   AS e2
        JOIN budget  AS b2 ON e2.event_id  = b2.link_to_event
        JOIN expense AS ex2 ON b2.budget_id = ex2.link_to_budget
        WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
      );

SELECT SUM(e.cost) * 100.0 / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS percentage
FROM event ev
JOIN budget b ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE ev.type = 'Meeting';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN superhero ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT 
    a.alignment,
    sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a 
    ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp 
    ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp 
    ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2
    ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
WHERE alignment_id = 1 
  AND gender_id = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eye_colour_difference
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T3.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_female_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female'
  AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name ASC;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY T1.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) 
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' 
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT A.attribute_name
FROM hero_attribute AS HA
JOIN attribute AS A ON HA.attribute_id = A.id
JOIN superhero AS S ON HA.hero_id = S.id
WHERE S.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY HA.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100
  AND T2.colour = 'brown';

SELECT T1.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute AS T1
JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.hero_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 100.0 *
       SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_female_born_after_1930
FROM Patient;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    p.Birthday, 
    e.`Examination Date`, 
    e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > '500';

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T1.SEX,
       T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
     ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) * 100.0 
       / (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F') AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5');

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."Examination Date") = '1997'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.Birthday = (
        SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
        FROM Patient p2
        WHERE p2.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination)
      );

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) / 12 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Date` BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT 
    T1.Date,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age_at_First_Visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
    / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS underage_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
)
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    P.Diagnosis AS doctor_diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E 
    ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory)
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT "T-CHO" < 250 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE ID = 2927464 
  AND Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UA = '8.4'
  AND T2.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`First Date` = '1991-06-13' 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Date) = '1995'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.Birthday = '1959-02-18' AND l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)
    -
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.Birthday = '1959-02-18' AND l.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)
    AS decrease_rate
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 
     ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'behcet'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Description) >= '1997'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Description) < '1998';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' 
  AND GPT > 30 
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.`Date` LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS average_albumin
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.PLT > 400
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997'
  AND NOT (TP > 6 AND TP < 8.5);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(julianday(`Examination Date`) - julianday(`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_exam
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 57266
  AND ((UA > 8.0 AND SEX = 'M') OR (UA > 6.5 AND SEX = 'F'));

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = '48473'
  AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) = 1994;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.GPT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALP,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    l.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.TP,
    l.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T3
        WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
     OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients_with_abnormal_creatinine
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(T1.SEX = 'M') > SUM(T1.SEX = 'F') 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`)
    FROM Laboratory
);

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT
    L.ID       AS patient_id,
    L."T-CHO"  AS t_cho
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
       / CAST(COUNT(Patient.ID) AS REAL) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.CPK < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.ID,
    T1.SEX,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS AGE
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180
  AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU < 180
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.WBC <= 3.5 OR l.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID, 
    P.Diagnosis, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    P.Description,
    P.`First Date`,
    P.Admission,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) = 1984
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 50
  AND CAST(L.PLT AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

WHERE T2.IGG > 900

SELECT T1.Diagnosis

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY T2.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA > 80

  AND CAST(substr(P.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT Diagnosis

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)

JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) >= '1985'
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RF < 20 AND T2.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.C3 > 35

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT <= 29 OR T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T1.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P

JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID)
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.SSB IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P

WHERE L.DNA >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT

FROM Laboratory

WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT < 60
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS First_Recorded_Date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT MAX(T1.Date) AS Latest_Record
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`First Date` = (SELECT MAX(`First Date`) FROM Patient)
  AND T1.LDH >= 500;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND T2.TP > 6.0
  AND T2.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5

FROM Examination AS T1

    SELECT T2.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F')

          SELECT MAX(UA)
          FROM Laboratory
          WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F')
            AND UA > 6.50
      )
);

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID

      SELECT MAX(T3.`aCL IgA`)

  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
  AND T3.SYMPTOMS IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

WHERE T2.CPK < 250
  AND (T3.KCT = '+' OR T3.RVVT = '+' OR T3.LAC = '+');

SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients

  AND L.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients

WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient

WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.PLT > 100
  AND T2.PLT < 400
  AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.PLT

SELECT AVG(T1.PT)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1

WHERE (T2.Thrombosis = 2 OR T2.Thrombosis = 1)

SELECT bond_type

ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(a.element = 'o') AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T2.atom_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T2.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
  AND T2.element = 'na';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

  AND m.label = '+';

FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT COUNT(*)

  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id

SELECT T1.label

JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'h'
GROUP BY T1.label
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.label) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
       a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b  ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
HAVING COUNT(a.element) = (
    SELECT COUNT(a2.element)
    FROM atom a2
    JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
    WHERE m2.label = '-'
    GROUP BY a2.element
    ORDER BY COUNT(a2.element) ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT T2.bond_type
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'sn'
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count

JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT c.atom_id2

JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT 100 - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
             / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
    ON T2.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, 
       a1.element AS atom1_element, 
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,

FROM connected c

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -

FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY molecule.label
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(bond_id), 
       5) AS percentage
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008';

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT bond_type 
FROM bond 
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element, molecule.label

JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.label

JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR010'

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'br';

SELECT B.bond_type, C.atom_id, C.atom_id2

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

SELECT T2.bond_type, T1.bond_id

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element

WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT T3.element
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS pct_carcinogenic_single_bonds
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 's';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND (a.element = 'p' OR a.element = 'br');

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' 
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'i';

SELECT MAX(label)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'ca'
)
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'c';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 
    ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 
    ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c'       -- element is carbon
  AND T4.bond_type = '#'     -- triple bond
  AND T1.label = '-'         -- non-carcinogenic
LIMIT 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS total
FROM atom
JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS con ON b.bond_id = con.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = con.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) 
                            FROM molecule) AS percent_triple_bond
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
                      FROM bond
                      WHERE bond_type = '#');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR151'
  AND atom.element IN ('cl', 'br', 'i', 'pb', 'sn', 'te');

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND substr(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) >= 10
  AND substr(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a 
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes - carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'No - not carcinogenic'
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label          AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_among_them
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule.molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT atom.molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE atom.element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule.molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT bond.molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT T1.bond_type
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 
    ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE (T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1');

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_carcinogenic_molecules_with_nitrogen
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
  AND molecule.label = 'TR024';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN molecule AS T2 
ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.label = 'TR008' AND T1.element = 'c';

SELECT T2.element
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR004_7';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom
JOIN connected 
    ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond 
    ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_with_triple_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' 
  AND atom.element = 'o';
SELECT MAX(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT T1.MailStreet

SELECT T2.Phone FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T1.Virtual = 'F'
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.NumTstTakr FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) FROM frpm)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 560 AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm INNER JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;

SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY T2.NumGE1500 / T2.NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT s.NCESSchool

SELECT T2.District FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active' ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT T1.sname, T2.CharterNum, T1.AvgScrWrite

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`County Name` = 'Fresno' AND T2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded' AND T1.NumTstTakr <= 250;
SELECT Phone FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' AND `Low Grade` = '9' AND `High Grade` = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*)

JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

  AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType

SELECT s.OpenDate

SELECT T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode GROUP BY T2.City ORDER BY SUM(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT frpm.`School Name`, schools.Website

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.[Charter School (Y/N)] = 1 ORDER BY T1.[Enrollment (K-12)] ASC LIMIT 1

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(TotalConsumption) AS Total, COUNT(*) AS Num
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption,
               MIN(TotalConsumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS MinConsumption
        FROM cust_totals
    )
    WHERE TotalConsumption = MinConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN CAST(Total AS REAL) / Num END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN CAST(Total AS REAL) / Num END) AS "SME - LAM",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN CAST(Total AS REAL) / Num END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN CAST(Total AS REAL) / Num END) AS "LAM - KAM",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN CAST(Total AS REAL) / Num END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN CAST(Total AS REAL) / Num END) AS "KAM - SME"
FROM lowest;

WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'A'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_later AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
),
balance_earlier AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
)
SELECT (balance_later.balance - balance_earlier.balance) * 100.0 / balance_earlier.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_later, balance_earlier;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_change
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT 'Biggest' AS change_type, Segment, pct_change
FROM pct
WHERE pct_change = (SELECT MAX(pct_change) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Lowest' AS change_type, Segment, pct_change
FROM pct
WHERE pct_change = (SELECT MIN(pct_change) FROM pct);

    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Price = 634.8 AND Date = '2012-08-25'
);
